title: Professional Services Agreement - TeachBar - Talent /Human Resources Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Agreement between the District and TeachBar, Oakland, CA, for the latter to organize ongoing scheduled teacher candidate classes; provide over a 12-month period approximately 2-3 classes in the Summer (Jun-Aug ‘20), Fall (Sep-Nov ‘20), Winter (Jan-Mar ‘21) and Spring (Apr-Jun ‘21) aligned to teacher candidate needs; use proprietary materials in addition to online tools and resources provided by District’s Talent Division and recommend teacher candidate use an independent test prep book for teacher candidate to practice problems and further reinforce their skills. via Talent /Human Resources Department, for the period of July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $56,800.00.

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Agreement - Jennifer Bloom - Talent / Human Resources Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Agreement between the District and Jennifer Bloom, Oakland, CA, for the latter to prepare for and co-coordinate California Commission on teacher Credentialing accreditation site visit schedule on behalf of the New Teacher Support and Development Program, as described; analyze continuous program improvement data aligned to the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing program and common standards and support the New Teacher Support and Development leadership team to make programmatic adjustments; lead the efforts to create a New Teacher Support and Development Advisory committee, as per the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing standards, as well as draft meeting agendas and co-facilitate quarterly advisory committee meetings’ and develop, participate in the application, interview, and hiring process for the New Teacher Support and Development stipend position of Lead Mentor, via Talent / Human Resources Department, for the period of July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $35,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $35,000 for a consultant on teacher credentialing review and mentoring
summary: An individual contractor will prepare for a state teacher-credentialing accreditation site visit for the New Teacher Support and Development Program. She will also analyze program data, set up an advisory committee, and help hire a lead mentor. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement for July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding and Interagency Agreement - District and San Jose State University - Intern Partnership and Practica Program - K12 Teaching - Talent/Human Resources Department

title: Community Based Organization Master Contract - District (Contractor) and Alameda County Behavior Health Care Services - Special Education Program Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Community Based Organization Master Contract between District (Contractor) and Alameda County Behavior Health Care Services, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide funding for Special Education Department to provide Counseling Enriched Special Day Class and Educationally Related Mental Health Service Assessments to enhance the capacity of schools to promote a positive school climate that identifies and addresses student behavioral health needs and is supportive of students at risk; promote partnerships with teachers, parents, and other providers to create a school environment that fosters healthy social emotional development through a continuum of prevention, early intervention, and tertiary services for students and families; professional development for teachers and administrators, direct parent and teacher consultation for the period of July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, via the Special Education Program Department, with compensation payable to the District hereunder not to  exceed $980,857.00 for the term of this Master Contract.

title: Early Childhood Education Verification of Closure Form - Governing Authority of the District
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education, as the Governing Authority of the Oakland Unified School District,  of the Verification of Closure of Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) Programs; certifying that said Programs have been closed for in-person instruction due to a local or state public health order or guidance and by order of the Board since March 2020, due to COVID-19;  that at some point the Board will discuss in a Public Hearing the ELC Program closure and will prepare a plan for safely reopening the ELC Program no later than when the District campuses reopens for in-person instruction; authorizes the President of the Board to execute said Verification on behalf of the Board, as required by CA SB 820 and Education Code Section 8209;  and further authorize the Superintendent of Schools or designee to transmit said Verification to the California Department of Education forthwith.
headline: Certifies that early learning and child care programs have been closed for in-person instruction
summary: The Board, acting as the district's governing authority, certifies that its Early Learning and Childcare (ELC) programs have been closed for in-person instruction since March 2020 because of COVID-19 health orders. It commits to hold a public hearing on the closure and prepare a safe reopening plan. The Board president signs the verification, and the Superintendent sends it to the California Department of Education.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
